text:
Aisha (CSM): FYI Sunnyside just hit our risk threshold  activation down 38% week-over-week. Renewal in ~6w. Suggest we spin a tight 10-day rapid-reengage.
Tom (CS Ops): Agree. Propose we limit touches: 1 kickoff, 1 enablement, 1 troubleshooting session, 1 exec check. Keep it high-signal.
Maya (Data): Quick snapshot: total seats flat, new-seat activation -41%, repeat users fell -32%. Feature Y usage collapsed. I'll attach a small CSV to the ticket.
Priya (Enablement): I can make a tiny "get-to-value" pack: 2 short how-tos (1 min), a 15-min power demo script, and a checklist for CSMs.
Jorge (AE): Customer mentioned perceived low ROI in last renewal nudge. We should prep a measured incentive (short-term credit) if they don't hit activation after the sprint. Low-cost but visible.
OnboardingBot: Created play instance: rapid_reengage_10d (pid: pr_907). Linked template: /playbooks/quick-retention.
Aisha (CSM): Draft sequence (minimal): Day 0: lightweight value email + calendar invite. Day 2: 15-min power demo focused on 1 metric. Day 5: hands-on fix session (screen share). Day 8: usage pulse + credit trigger. Day 10: final exec recap.
Tom (CS Ops): Ops checklist: tag account `10d_reengage=true`, mute renewal automation, quick billing check for credits. Also ensure support routing priority for any tech issues during sprint.
Maya (Data): Pulse rule: if activation + feature-Y events together < 20% improvement by Day 7, flag for credit offer. I'll add a dashboard widget showing 7d delta, activation %, and last activity.
Priya (Enablement): Email subject suggestion: "Quick 10-day plan to restore [Top KPI]" Body will include 3 clear wins and a one-click scheduling button. I'll drop assets in the play ticket by EOD.
Jorge (AE): Draft credit wording: "If core activation doesn't improve by 20% in 7 days, we'll apply a one-time $75 performance credit." I'll route to legal for an expedited OK. Keep it capped and simple.
Aisha (CSM): Outreach tone: supportive, outcome-first. Avoid sounding salesy. Primary goal: unblock feature adoption and show immediate wins.
Tom (CS Ops): Assignments: Tom -> tagging + billing check (today). Priya -> enablement bundle + email copy (EOD). Maya -> dashboard + CSV (today). Jorge -> credit blurb to legal (tomorrow). Aisha -> run outreach and schedule sessions.
Aisha (CSM): Quick script for 15-min call: "What's the one number you need to move? In 15 minutes I'll show two steps you can take now to change it." End with clear next step and ownership.
Maya (Data): Adding retention cohort: seats created in last 90 days with <2 feature Y events. That cohort is driving the drop. Recommend prioritizing those users in outreach.
OnboardingBot: Ticket CS-22451 created, linked to pr_907.
Aisha (CSM): Let's meet 30m tomorrow 11am PT to finalize materials and assign CSM owners. If anything slips, post updates here. :spiral_calendar:
Priya (Enablement): I'll be there and will upload the 2 how-tos pre-meeting.
Tom (CS Ops): Noted. I'll prep the tagging script and escalation steps.
Jorge (AE): Will follow up on legal, should be quick for a small credit.
Aisha (CSM): Thanks all  aim to get first outreach out by EOD tomorrow so we get full 10 days before renewal touch.
